why: Multiple 2025 papers (Chan's INTEGERS note, arXiv 2503.21485, arXiv 2507.16828) rule out specific structural families of consecutive powerful triples (e.g. middle term a perfect cube, or single prime-power factors), which settles cases of the conjecture even though the full statement remains open.

found.title: A note on three consecutive powerful numbers
found.note: Proves nonexistence of triplets with middle term a perfect cube and outer terms single prime-power factors, via Pell equations/elliptic curves.

found.title: Nonexistence of Consecutive Powerful Triplets Around Cubes with Prime-Square Factors
found.note: Extends prior result eliminating another family of potential counterexamples centered at a perfect cube, using modular and elliptic curve methods.

found.title: A note on three consecutive powerful numbers (Tsz Ho Chan, INTEGERS 25)
found.note: Published version of a case-settling result on the conjecture.
